paragraphs.text: The lift in block C will be out of use from Monday 6 May for approximately four days. Engineers will work between 8 am and 6 pm and will keep the stairwell clear at all times.
Residents who cannot use the stairs should contact the office before 3 May; help with shopping and bin bags will be arranged. The lift in block B is available to all residents during the works.

items.prompt: The lift will be out of use for about four days.
Residents needing help should contact the office in advance.
The repairs are needed because of an accident.
